frequency_question: What proportion of threatened indefinite nationwide strikes by major labor coalitions result in actual execution rather than settlement or postponement before the deadline?
membership_rule: Includes: formally announced nationwide or industry-wide indefinite strike notices by major umbrella union coalitions. Excludes: localized single-employer strikes, wildcat strikes without central union backing, or mere rhetoric without formal notice.
window: A window of 1 to 3 months following the initial major strike notice or escalation threshold.
